strings.name: Ales Bialiatski
strings.summary: Bialiatski moved from literature into Belarusian democratic activism, founding Viasna in 1996 to aid prisoners and document abuses. Imprisoned in 2011–2014 and again from 2021, he shared the 2022 peace Nobel. A ten-year sentence followed in 2023, condemned as political by rights groups. Released in December 2025, he continued advocacy in 2026.
